landed.uploaded_as: 3 commits on claude/0017-settler-ui-turn-time (GitLab API), squashed on merge; branch tree compared with the tested tree before merging

relationship_to_prior_patch: Incremental on GitLab main after merge request !41 (patch 0016). Do not reapply earlier patches.

changes.settler_without_cities: CvUnitAI::AI_found: a player without cities lets its settler travel without an escort. On Earth 12, Genghis Khan's start plot cannot hold a city, China founds next to the plot his settler walks to, and the settler then waited forever for an escort no city could train. Present in the original RoM DLL (d8cedd5).
changes.plot_list_redraw: CvUnit (4 sites) and CvSelectionGroup (1 site) set the PlotListButtons dirty bit when the unit's plot equals the selection plot; with nothing selected both are NULL. They now require a plot.
changes.hover_help: CvGameTextMgr::setPlotListHelp cleared a 423 x 51 x 244 promotion table (about 21 MB) on every hover over a stack of more than 15 units; rows are now allocated and cleared only for unit types on the plot, and DeInitialize empties the table.
changes.update_score: CvGame::updateScore called Python calculateScore players x players times; each score is computed once, ranks unchanged.
changes.can_build: CvPlayer::canBuild tests the tech requirement before the plot.
changes.best_route: CvPlayer::getBestRoute scans the route builds sorted by route value, first usable wins; same result.
changes.extra_cost: CvPlayer::calculatePreInflatedCosts calls Python getExtraCost (returns 0 in RoM) only when PythonCallbackDefines.xml sets USE_GET_EXTRA_COST_CALLBACK; the patch adds it with value 0.

measured.identical_games: harness, Mediterranean Marathon Noble, seeds 1 and 2, to turn 450: telemetry identical between the 0016 and 0017 DLLs apart from timing
measured.earth12: Earth 12 Marathon Noble seeds 1 and 2: Genghis Khan founds his capital on turn 1 (before: no city in any game); the games differ from turn 1 on as a result
measured.turn_time: 10 turns from the turn-400 Mediterranean Marathon snapshot, two repetitions each: 34.3 and 35.3 s (0016) vs 32.2 and 31.7 s (0017), -8 %; the harness does not run RoM's Python, so the skipped getExtraCost calls save more in the game

validation.regression_suite: 32 isolated checks pass on the tested tree
